<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that breaks an S‑Cl bond and forms an S‑N bond, which corresponds to the sulfonamide formation described. This will give us the template ID to later apply to the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O",
    "bonds_broken": ["S-Cl"],
    "bonds_formed": ["S-N"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
